raw_summary: Equine chiropractors across the DFW/North Texas and Montana circuit emphasize performance-driven messaging centered on solving concrete problems: uneven gaits, lead issues, behavioral resistance, and post-event recovery. Content hooks pivot away from pain-as-the-primary-driver and instead address nerve function, compensation patterns, and biomechanical imbalance—framing chiropractic as a performance optimization tool for rodeo athletes (barrel, roping, bronc) and ranch horses. Visual content heavily favors close-up adjustment technique, before/after gait videos, and candid relaxation moments. Masterson Method and VOM (Veterinary Orthopedic Manipulation) appear frequently among advanced practitioners. Mobile practitioners emphasize barn-call convenience and integration with farriers, trainers, and vets. Educational short-form video (30–60 seconds) on Instagram Reels and Facebook is the dominant platform format, with emphasis on consistency over virality.
